title.en: Whereas / While / On the other hand

sentences.target: '-(으)ㄴ 반면에'는 두 대상이나 상황의 상반된 특징을 대조적으로 제시할 때 사용된다.
sentences.en: This form is used to present contrasting characteristics between two subjects or situations.

sentences.target: 앞 절과 뒤 절의 특성이 서로 반대되거나 균형을 이루는 경우에 자연스럽다.
sentences.en: It is natural when the traits of the first and second clauses are opposite or balanced.

sentences.target: 긍정적·부정적 요소를 함께 제시하여 비교할 수 있다.
sentences.en: It can compare both positive and negative aspects together.

sentences.target: 사실적 정보뿐 아니라 인상, 분위기 등 비정량적 요소도 대조할 수 있다.
sentences.en: It can contrast not only factual information but also impressions and non-quantitative traits.

sentences.target: '하지만', '그러나'와 달리 한 문장 안에서 균형 잡힌 비교를 만든다.
sentences.en: Unlike ‘but’ or ‘however’, it creates a balanced comparison within a single sentence.

sentences.target: 문어·구어 모두에서 사용 가능하지만 설명적 문맥에서 더 자주 쓰인다.
sentences.en: It appears in both spoken and written contexts but is more common in explanatory writing.

sentences.target: 두 요소의 차이를 명확하고 논리적으로 보여 준다.
sentences.en: It clearly and logically shows differences between the two elements.

sentences.target: 대조적 속성을 동시에 평가할 때 효과적이다.
sentences.en: It is effective when evaluating opposing qualities simultaneously.

sentences.target: 비판적 분석뿐 아니라 객관적 비교에서도 활용 가능하다.
sentences.en: It works not only for critical analysis but also for objective comparison.

sentences.target: 상황이나 대상의 양면성을 설명할 때 유용한 표현이다.
sentences.en: It is useful when describing two-sided or contrasting aspects of a situation.

sentences.target: 그는 조용한 반면에 동생은 적극적이다.
sentences.en: He is quiet, whereas his younger sibling is outgoing.

sentences.target: 가격은 높은 반면에 품질은 뛰어나다.
sentences.en: The price is high, whereas the quality is excellent.

sentences.target: 속도는 빠른 반면에 안정성은 떨어진다.
sentences.en: The speed is fast, whereas the stability is low.

sentences.target: 공간은 좁은 반면에 활용도는 높다.
sentences.en: The space is small, whereas the usability is high.

sentences.target: 준비는 부족한 반면에 결과는 좋았다.
sentences.en: The preparation was lacking, whereas the result was good.

sentences.target: 시간은 짧은 반면에 배운 내용은 많았다.
sentences.en: The time was short, whereas the amount learned was large.

sentences.target: 그 지역은 조용한 반면에 교통이 불편하다.
sentences.en: The area is quiet, whereas the transportation is inconvenient.

sentences.target: 디자인은 단순한 반면에 기능은 다양하다.
sentences.en: The design is simple, whereas the functions are diverse.

sentences.target: 문제는 복잡한 반면에 해결책은 분명하다.
sentences.en: The problem is complex, whereas the solution is clear.

sentences.target: 팀 규모는 작은 반면에 성과는 안정적이다.
sentences.en: The team is small, whereas the performance is stable.

sentences.target: 경험은 부족한 반면에 이해도는 높았다.
sentences.en: The experience is limited, whereas the understanding is high.

sentences.target: 작업량은 많은 반면에 마감은 여유로웠다.
sentences.en: The workload was heavy, whereas the deadline was generous.

sentences.target: 요구 조건은 많은 반면에 실제 난도는 낮았다.
sentences.en: The requirements were many, whereas the actual difficulty was low.

sentences.target: 경쟁은 치열한 반면에 기회도 많았다.
sentences.en: The competition was intense, whereas the opportunities were plentiful.

sentences.target: 환경은 열악한 반면에 팀워크는 좋았다.
sentences.en: The environment was poor, whereas the teamwork was good.

sentences.target: 변수는 많은 반면에 결과는 예측 가능했다.
sentences.en: There were many variables, whereas the result was predictable.

sentences.target: 비용은 높은 반면에 효율은 떨어졌다.
sentences.en: The cost was high, whereas the efficiency was low.

sentences.target: 변화는 빠른 반면에 적용은 느렸다.
sentences.en: The changes were quick, whereas the implementation was slow.

sentences.target: 선택지는 적은 반면에 결정은 쉬웠다.
sentences.en: The options were few, whereas the decision was easy.

sentences.target: 압박은 큰 반면에 성과는 안정적이었다.
sentences.en: The pressure was high, whereas the performance was stable.
